description_en: Queries the detailed configurations of domain names that have been added to WAF for protection
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainAdvanceConfigs查询已添加到WAF防护的域名的详细配置
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-domain-advance-configs --instance-id waf-cn-2r427ng0000 --domain-list www.aliyundoc.com --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainAdvanceConfigs

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain names whose configurations you want to query. You can specify multiple domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html to query all domain names that have been added to WAF for protection
parameters.help_zh:
要查询配置详情的域名。支持同时设置多个域名，多个域名间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html查询所有已接入WAF防护的域名
parameters.name: domain_list

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the domain name belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default resource group is used
parameters.help_zh:
网站域名在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

DomainConfigs.description_en: The detailed configuration information of the domain names

CertStatus.description_en:
The certificate status (the HTTPS protocol status). Valid values:

0: abnormal. For example, no certificate is uploaded, or the uploaded certificate is invalid.

1: normal. A certificate is uploaded and the certificate is valid
CertStatus.description_zh:
证书状态（即HTTPS协议状态）。取值：

0：表示异常，例如，未上传证书、上传的证书无效。

1：表示正常，已上传证书且证书有效

ClusterType.description_en:
The cluster type of the WAF instance. Valid values:

0 (default): physical cluster.
1: virtual cluster, which is a WAF exclusive cluster
ClusterType.description_zh:
WAF实例的集群类别。取值：

0（默认）：表示物理集群。
1：表示虚拟集群，即WAF独享集群

Cname.description_en: The CNAME address assigned by the WAF instance for the domain name configuration
Cname.description_zh: WAF实例为该域名配置分配的CNAME地址

ExclusiveVipStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether an exclusive IP address is used. Valid values:

0: no.

1: yes
ExclusiveVipStatus.description_zh:
是否使用独享IP。取值：

0：表示否。

1：表示是

GSLBStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether intelligent load balancing is enabled. Valid values:

off: disabled.

on: enabled
GSLBStatus.description_zh:
是否启用智能负载均衡。取值：

off：表示否。

on：表示是

Ipv6Status.description_en:
Indicates whether IPv6 security protection is enabled. Valid values:

0: disabled.

1: enabled
Ipv6Status.description_zh:
是否开启IPv6安全防护。取值：

0：表示关闭。

1：表示开启

ResolvedType.description_en:
The type of the CNAME records to parse. Valid values:

-1: points to the origin server.

0: points to the WAF instance IP address.

1: points to the WAF virtual cluster IP address
ResolvedType.description_zh:
CNAME解析记录类型。取值：

-1：表示指向源站服务器。

0：表示指向WAF实例IP。

1：表示指向WAF虚拟集群IP

Rs.description_en: The list of origin server addresses

VipServiceStatus.description_en:
The service status of the WAF instance IP address (or WAF virtual cluster IP address) currently in use. Valid values:

0: Normal.

1: The system scrubs traffic.

2: The system is in blackhole filtering status
VipServiceStatus.description_zh:
当前使用的WAF实例IP（或WAF虚拟集群IP）的服务状态。取值：

0：表示正常。

1：表示正在进行流量清洗。

2：表示处于黑洞状态
